news.title: Spectra is on Android
news.body: Get Spectra for Android from the download page: your library, friends and achievements on your phone, and Prismfall with touch controls.

news.title: Prismfall 1.0 is live
news.body: One hull. Endless light. Steer, aim and fire your way through the rift in Spectra Games' neon survival shooter.

games.title: Prismfall
games.tagline: One hull. Endless light. Survive the rift.
games.description: A neon arena survival shooter. Steer your hull, aim your prism cannon and fire by hand while you dash and harvest light shards to level up. Stay inside the red border of the rift, survive escalating swarms, and break the Prism Wraith when it breaches.
features: Hands-on tank controls: thrust, turn, aim and fire yourself
A big arena with a follow camera, and a deadly red border
30 escalating upgrades in five rarities, from Common to Legendary
Online multiplayer for up to 4: co-op waves with revives, or versus rounds. Invite friends from Spectra Launcher
Nine hostile types, from charging lancers to healers and phase-shifting phantoms, plus the Prism Wraith boss
29 achievements and an Icon Kit of unlockable hulls and colours
A live synthwave soundtrack (menu, chase and boss themes) and synth effects, all generated in real time

notes: Game modes: Normal (beat the Rift Titan to win), Endless, Boss Rush and Creative; in co-op also Waves (30 waves) and Endless Waves
Versus teams (2v2, 3v3, 4v4) and a new Infection mode
7 maps with differently shaped voids, and optional obstacles you can't see past (Ricochet bolts bounce off them)
Optional modifiers (Fog, Glass Cannon, Swarm, Ironclad, Haste, Bullet Hell, Famine, Brittle) that raise your reward
Prisms: a currency earned by beating the rift, more on harder difficulties and with modifiers (nothing to spend them on yet)
Creative mode (beat every boss on Hard) and an Icon Creator for your own hull (beat every boss on Medium)
Arrows to off-screen teammates and bosses, switch who you spectate while down, and 5 seconds to get back from the void
5 new achievements, one for beating the Rift Titan on each difficulty, plus trophy tiers in Spectra Launcher
Wardens nerfed a lot: half the hull, a weaker and narrower shield, and they turn slowly
Creative menu fixed (its buttons didn't respond to clicks) and it no longer pauses the game
Creative in co-op: everyone gets the menu, as long as everyone in the room has Creative unlocked
Classes: Striker (bolts), Lancer (laser beam), Artillery (exploding shells), Engineer (seeker darts) and Vanguard (scattergun), each with its own stats
Your class's upgrades come up 3× as often; off-class upgrades stop at 2–3 picks
Creative menu: search, sort and filter upgrades, hover to see the card, and switch level-up upgrades off
Hulls and colours are now bought with prisms in the Icon Kit (anything you'd already unlocked stays yours)
Initial release
Manual tank controls with a follow camera and a deadly red arena border
Nine hostile types plus the Prism Wraith boss
30 escalating upgrades in five rarities, picked from a hand of cards
29 achievements, a main menu, Icon Kit and settings
A live synthwave soundtrack that switches between menu, chase and boss themes
Online multiplayer (up to 10 players): co-op waves and versus rounds, with room codes and launcher invites
Plays on Android in Spectra for Android, with twin-stick touch controls
Fullscreen by default
Multiplayer: levels are per player, and each level-up brings upgrade cards straight away, even mid-wave
Multiplayer: exactly one upgrade per level-up, however fast you click
Co-op: choose Waves or Endless (single-player style, downed players back after 20s)
Multiplayer runs far smoother when everyone is firing: bolts, ships and glows are pre-rendered, off-screen objects are skipped, and network updates are about half the size
Settings redesigned: Audio and Display groups, neon volume sliders with live values, a new Effects volume slider and a reset-to-defaults button
FPS counter under BEST (can be turned off in Settings)
Pause menu redesigned: Resume and Main Menu beside the full Audio and Display options (volume sliders, fullscreen, screen shake, FPS counter)
15 new hostiles that join after each boss (1 after the first, 2 after the second... until all are in)
5 new bosses after the Prism Wraith: Hive Queen, Comet Tyrant, Spiral Oracle, Mirror Colossus and Rift Titan
Shards are the colour of the player who made the kill and only they can collect them; bosses drop a share for everyone
23 new upgrades, and the epics reworked: Satellites hit for full bolt damage with knockback, Nova Pulse is much stronger and wipes out hostile shots
Second Dawn in co-op: fly over a downed teammate to bring them back
New Secret rarity with its own odds: Event Horizon (1 in 10,000) and Annihilator (1 in 100,000)
14 new achievements: one for each new boss, Pantheon, Rift Warden, Blitz and Flawless, plus five for Secret upgrades
Upgrade cards are much easier to read, and the multiplayer card tray keeps full-size text
PC: your cannon aims at the mouse (crosshair and a barrel on your ship), separate from the way you fly
Phones: twin thumbsticks, left to move and right to aim and fire
Five difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, Insane and Nightmare (harder runs score more)
Multiplayer for up to 10 players, and everyone always flies a different colour
Invite friends straight from the lobby: they get a popup in Spectra Launcher or Prismfall
7 new hull shapes and 10 new colours in the Icon Kit
New upgrade cards stay locked for a moment so a stray click can't pick one
